hardware.riscv.summary: An RV32I instruction-set simulator: run a program and read back the registers, memory and cycle count.
hardware.riscv.where: The simulator is written: lib/rv32/sim.viv is an RV32IM instruction-set simulator in Viv that passes the riscv-tests rv32ui and rv32um suites, and the gallery runs a C program on it. The Python binding vp.hardware.riscv is not built yet.
